narrative:
The FY2027 plan carries EUR 1.27B of revenue, up 5.2% on the FY2026 Q3 forecast of EUR 1.21B and EUR 30M short of the EUR 1.30B ambition.

Revenue is planned as care days × revenue per care day. Inpatient rehab is the engine at EUR 949M (75% of the plan): the nine former Paracelsus clinics ramp up occupancy and DRV daily rates rise about 4.5%. Outpatient rehab (EUR 132M, +9.5%) and MVZ (EUR 53M, +8.1%) grow fastest as DRV shifts suitable indications to outpatient care. Acute (EUR 65M) is planned prudently while the hospital-reform service groups are allocated; care homes (EUR 61M) hold about 91% occupancy.

Key risk: Swiss rehab occupancy is below 85% while cantonal tariffs are pending — the Patient Volume Forecaster has EUR 34M of proposals on the table to close the gap to ambition.
